verdict.rationale: Entra's Lifecycle Workflows manage users across the three phases of their lifecycle, with processes that run automatically as users move through it [docs-5, docs-18]. Automatic SCIM provisioning to SaaS and on-prem apps covers the app-by-app downstream work [docs-3, docs-4, docs-26]. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a no-code workflow designer, detail on the specific trigger events (hire date, attribute or role change, departure), how workflow tasks chain to per-app provisioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
